title: Semantic Versioning for Data
description: Applies MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH semantics where MAJOR means breaking schema change. Recorded facts — Practice: Semantic Versioning for Data; Mechanism: version numbers; Guarantee: meaningful versions. Used by data stewards, researchers, and ML teams who must reproduce results years later.
demo:
# Semantic Versioning for Data — runnable demo (python3)
# Semantic Versioning for Data - version stamp and checksum (python3)
import hashlib, re
name='cohort-v3'
salt='n3'
m=re.search(r'v(\d+)', name)
print("version:", m.group(1) if m else "UNVERSIONED")
digest=hashlib.sha256((name+salt).encode()).hexdigest()
print("checksum:", digest[:16])
print("STAMPED" if m else "ADD VERSION")
